connector.name: LegalSearch
connector.registryDescription: Public Indian legal search MCP for Roop judgments, statutes, and corpus grounding.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.roopslaw.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.roopslaw. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional bearer token for authenticated LegalSearch access. Use: Bearer ${ROOP_PUBLIC_MCP_API_KEY}
